questions.q: Which role sits at the very top of Cascade's role hierarchy, built in this lesson?
questions.explain: Monica Reyes's VP of Sales role is the root of the seven-role hierarchy; every other role sits beneath it.

questions.q: Why do Priya Nair, Angela Wu, and Marcus Webb's roles report directly to the VP of Sales instead of through Derek Oyelaran's Sales Manager role?
options: Salesforce role hierarchies can only be two levels deep
Each of them leads a separate branch of the business -- Key Accounts, Customer Success, Service & Installation -- that isn't part of the New Business sales team Oyelaran manages
Oyelaran's profile doesn't allow him to manage other roles
They were added to the org after Oyelaran and roles can't be reparented
questions.explain: This carries the Lesson 4 design forward: those three roles are deliberately separate branches so Oyelaran doesn't automatically inherit visibility into Key Accounts, Customer Success, or Service data.

questions.q: Which Organization-Wide Default setting does this lesson apply to all five of Cascade's core objects?
questions.explain: Account, Contact, Opportunity, Lead, Installation Project, and Service Contract are all set to Private, the tight baseline Lesson 4 called for.

questions.q: What access does the Service -> Opportunity sharing rule grant, and to whom?
options: Full (Read/Write/Transfer) access to the Sales Manager profile
Edit access to Customer Success on Service Contract
Delete access to IT on all closed Opportunities
Read-only access to Marcus Webb's Service & Installation role on Opportunity records they don't own
questions.explain: The rule is owner-based and grants Read Only -- just enough for the Service & Installation team to see the won Opportunity behind an Installation Project, nothing broader.

questions.q: Which profile stays the unmodified, standard System Administrator profile instead of being cloned and customized?
options: System Administrator, assigned only to IT
questions.explain: System Administrator is left as the standard Salesforce profile and assigned only to IT; the other four profiles are clones of Standard User, customized per job function.
